name: nicepayapi
description: Structured Nicepay Merchant API reference compiled from the public documentation for AI Copilot usage in this repository.
doc_warnings: Classic payment docs list customer in the table, but the example body uses account. Client code should tolerate both variants.
Payout response docs are inconsistent: the response table mentions payout_id, while the example success payload shows payment_id.
H2H docs mix paymentId and payment_id across responses. Parsers should support both names.
Merchant handler docs describe GET callback parameters. Production code can still be tolerant to POST form or JSON bodies, but GET remains the documented contract.

notes: Nicepay Merchant API does not use Bearer authentication for the flows covered here.
Credentials are passed in the request body for payment, payout, and H2H endpoints.

money_format.implementation_rule: Inside domain logic use Decimal; convert to integer minor units only when building Nicepay requests.

notes: If method is provided but not enabled for the merchant, payment creation fails.
If success_url or fail_url is omitted, Nicepay uses the merchant site URL.
Use order_id as your stable local payment identifier or payload reference.

payment_callback.delivery: GET request to merchant callback URL from merchant settings
payment_callback.retry_policy: If the merchant server does not answer, Nicepay retries after 1 minute.
required_validations: Verify hash before any business action.
Compare merchant_id with configured merchant id.
Load local payment by order_id and verify provider, amount, currency, and payment_id consistency.
Make callback processing idempotent because retries are expected.

steps: Sort remaining parameters by key in alphabetical order.
Take only the values in that sorted key order.
Append merchant secret to the end of the values array.
Join all values with the literal separator {np}.
Compute sha256 hex digest and compare with the provided hash using constant-time comparison.

payment_methods.method_note: The payment methods page mentions nicewallet_usdt, but the classic payment creation page lists supported currencies as USD, EUR, RUB, UAH, KZT. Do not assume USDT classic payment support without validation against the merchant account.

h2h.purpose: Direct host-to-host flow where the merchant fetches methods, details, and statuses instead of redirecting the customer to Nicepay payment page.
flow_options: Step-by-step flow using payment, h2hPaymentInfo, h2hSelectMethod, h2hConfirmPaid, and h2hUploadProof

response_notes: details_found returns payment details, status, expire, methods, details, amount, amountNum, additionalFee, and proof state.
details_not_found can return payment_id, amount, currency, link, and expired.
H2H payloads can use both paymentId and payment_id.

required_fields.method: one of methods returned by h2hPaymentInfo

confirm_paid.note: This call is explicitly described as mandatory after the customer reports payment. It advances the payment lifecycle and starts processing time.

statuses.0: Payment created, waiting for payment method selection.
statuses.1: Searching transfer details after method selection.
statuses.2: Searching transfer details after method selection.
statuses.3: Waiting for transfer by displayed details.
statuses.4: Waiting for payment confirmation after customer action.
statuses.81: Under moderator review after proof upload.
statuses.82: Final status. Closed by moderators without payment completion.
statuses.93: Customer did not confirm payment; proof upload is expected.
statuses.95: Final status. Cancelled by system timeout.

recommended_flow: Create payment and optionally receive details immediately through h2hOneRequestPayment.
If using step-by-step flow, create payment first and then fetch h2hPaymentInfo.
If status is 0, choose a method through h2hSelectMethod.
Poll h2hPaymentInfo to obtain updated payment details and transfer requisites.
After customer says they paid, call h2hConfirmPaid.
Continue polling h2hPaymentInfo until a final status is reached.
If needed, upload receipt or proof file on status 4 or 93.

processing_logic: After payout creation, Nicepay creates a processing request.
If payout succeeds, merchant receives a handler callback.
If payout is not processed within 24 hours, it is cancelled and funds are returned to merchant balance, followed by callback notification.

fee_merchant_semantics.true: Commission is charged to the merchant.
fee_merchant_semantics.false: Commission is deducted from the payout amount.

payout_callback.delivery: GET request to merchant payout handler URL
payout_callback.signature: Same sorting and sha256({np}) formula as payment callback.

required: Merchant site should be hosted on a second-level domain and use paid hosting.
All site links should be active and lead to relevant pages.
Goods or services being paid for must be clearly described.
Contacts page should expose valid contact information such as email, Telegram, or feedback form.
Terms, user agreement, and refund policy should be publicly available.
If business activity requires licensing, the site should display license information or permissions.
For Telegram channels, the channel must remain public during operation.
prohibited_examples: Unlicensed donations or sponsorship processing where licensing is required.
Counterfeit goods, copyright-infringing goods, or unlicensed software sales.
Pornographic materials, escort services, erotic massage, rare or exotic animals.
Magic or psychic services, financial pyramids, investment scams, loan brokerage abuse.
Sale of card credentials, personal data, or unlawful data access.

implemented: Payment callback parsing and sha256 hash verification.
Pending local payment creation before sending payment URL to the user.
Wallet credit only after verified final Nicepay callback.
Webhook server for Nicepay callback handling.
Tests covering signature verification and invalid hash rejection.

implementation_rules: Preserve the existing classic payment flow as the main working integration path.
Do not switch Nicepay integration to Bearer auth.
Do not send money in major units; always use integer minor units.
Do not change the documented callback hash formula.
When documentation conflicts with examples, write tolerant parsers and tests instead of trusting only one variant.
For new Nicepay features, add tests for signature verification, repeated callbacks, amount mismatch, and inconsistent field names.

copilot_prompt_lines: Ты работаешь с интеграцией Nicepay Merchant API в Python-проекте CERBER. Используй этот JSON как рабочий reference и не придумывай поведение, которого здесь нет.
Nicepay Merchant API использует merchant_id и secret в теле запроса, а не Bearer token.
Базовый URL по умолчанию: https://nicepay.io.
Все суммы передаются в minor units: центы или копейки. 35.40 USD передаётся как 3540.
В проекте уже реализован рабочий классический flow создания платежа, callback-валидация и зачисление средств после подтверждённого callback.

При изменениях переиспользуй существующие модули src/cerber_bot/integrations/nicepay.py, src/cerber_bot/services/payments.py, src/cerber_bot/nicepay_webhook.py и настройки из src/cerber_bot/config.py.
Для денег внутри доменной логики используй Decimal, а в Nicepay отправляй целые minor units.
Для callback и payout handler делай обработку идемпотентной, потому что Nicepay повторяет запрос через 1 минуту, если не получил ответ.
Классический платёж создаётся через POST /public/api/payment с merchant_id, secret, order_id, customer или account, amount, currency и опциональными description, method, success_url, fail_url.
В документации create payment есть расхождение: таблица требует customer, а пример показывает account. Поддерживай оба варианта.
Callback по платежу приходит с result, payment_id, merchant_id, order_id, amount, amount_currency, profit, profit_currency, method, hash.
Перед любым зачислением средств обязательно проверяй hash, merchant_id, order_id, payment_id, amount и currency против локальной записи.

Hash считается так: убрать hash, отсортировать параметры по имени ключа, взять только значения, добавить secret в конец, склеить через {np}, посчитать sha256 hex и сравнить с переданным значением constant-time сравнением.
Методы оплаты по валютам смотри в объекте reference.payment_methods этого файла и не подставляй неподключённые методы.
H2H режим нужен, если мерчант не хочет редиректить клиента на страницу Nicepay и сам показывает методы, реквизиты и статусы.
Для H2H есть OneRequest endpoint /public/api/h2hOneRequestPayment и пошаговый flow через h2hPaymentInfo, h2hSelectMethod, h2hConfirmPaid и h2hUploadProof.
В H2H после сообщения клиента об оплате вызов h2hConfirmPaid обязателен.
H2H upload proof принимает JPG, PNG или PDF до 1 МБ и допускается на статусах 4 или 93.
Если реализуешь H2H, поддерживай расхождения paymentId и payment_id в ответах документации.
Выплаты создаются через POST /public/api/payout и используют merchant_id, secret, order_id, balance, method, wallet, amount, comment, fee_merchant.
Для payout docs тоже есть расхождение: где-то указан payout_id, а где-то payment_id. Пиши устойчивый парсер.
Payout callback использует result success_payout или error_payout и ту же формулу hash, что обычный payment callback.
Не предлагай интеграции для запрещённых категорий проектов и учитывай merchant rules из этого файла.
Если документация и пример расходятся, делай код и тесты так, чтобы поддерживать оба документированных варианта, а не слепо доверять одному примеру.
Если добавляешь новые возможности Nicepay в CERBER, сначала проверь текущую бизнес-логику пополнения кошелька и не ломай существующий классический payment flow.
